status.detail: Three earlier native restores placed packages beside their manifests rather than at the expected repository-root imports, so no build or test followed. The next assigned sequence used the standard NuGet root-package destination, but its first logger restore failed because the required CppWinRT package was not found in the configured local feeds. It stopped immediately; remaining restores, import checks, production and test builds, test discovery, and tests were not run. No TRX exists. The actual feed and cache discrepancy is being reconciled before another assigned validation sequence. These orchestration failures do not establish a product defect, completed validation, or review convergence.
